_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: two 'all' statements in a chain; 2: an 'all' and a 'some', where a decision only turns a statement round; 3: 'some' statements chained, or 'no' mixed with 'all'; 4: three statements or three decisions, or a statement with 'most'. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
